name: Small Groups
overview: Scripture highlights the vital role of small groups in fostering mutual encouragement, spiritual growth, and fellowship among believers. As Proverbs 27:17 illustrates, believers sharpen one another like iron sharpens iron, while Matthew 18:20 assures Christ’s presence when two or three gather in His name. The early church exemplified this through steadfast devotion to teaching, fellowship, prayer, and breaking bread together (Acts 2:42, 46), all grounded in Christ’s command to love one another as He loved us (John 13:34). This intimate community setting serves both to exhort and to nurture believers in faith and unity.
